title: Release of the N1 NAS signalling connection

entities.name: Release of N1 NAS signalling connection
entities.description: Procedure for releasing the N1 NAS signalling connection, initiated by the network or locally by the UE under specific conditions.

entities.name: Timer T3540
entities.description: Timer used to control the local release of the N1 NAS signalling connection after specific conditions are met.

entities.name: Timer T3444
entities.description: Timer started when N1 NAS signalling connection for eCall over IMS is released in eCall only mode.

entities.name: Timer T3445
entities.description: Timer started when N1 NAS signalling connection for call to HPLMN designated non-emergency MSISDN/URI is released in eCall only mode.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: State entered by UE upon release of access stratum connection, indicating N1 NAS signalling connection is released.

entities.name: UE request type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating type of request in REGISTRATION REQUEST or SERVICE REQUEST messages.

entities.name: Follow-on request indicator
entities.description: IE indicating whether follow-on request is pending in REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: eCall only mode condition
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured for eCall only mode as specified in 3GPP TS 31.102.

entities.name: 5GMM cause values condition
entities.description: Condition based on specific 5GMM cause values received in messages.

entities.name: Local release of N1 NAS signalling connection
entities.description: Action where UE locally releases the N1 NAS signalling connection upon timer expiry or specific conditions.

relations.description: Release of N1 NAS signalling connection causes UE to enter 5GMM-IDLE mode.
In eCall only mode, if N1 connection for eCall over IMS is released, UE starts T3444.
In eCall only mode, if N1 connection for call to HPLMN non-emergency MSISDN/URI is released, UE starts T3445.
UE starts T3540 upon receiving specific 5GMM cause values in messages.
Setting Request type to specific values influences starting of T3540.
Follow-on request indicator setting affects whether UE may locally release N1 connection.
Upon T3540 expiry, UE locally releases the N1 NAS signalling connection.
UE stops T3540 upon specific events like user-plane resource setup or receipt of certain messages.
